signup.welcome_body:
FREE Mode — registration required.

We'll ask for name, email, phone, and country. We'll use this information only to:
 • Confirm your identity
 • Send lovarch-cli updates (opt-out anytime)
 • Enable future Premium upgrade with the same account

Your data is GDPR-protected. You can delete it with [bold]lovarch account delete[/bold] anytime.
signup.prompt_country: Country code ISO 3166 (e.g. US, IT, BR, ES)
signup.prompt_consent: Do you accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy (GDPR)?
signup.consent_required: GDPR consent is required. Signup cancelled.
signup.invalid_phone: Phone must be in international format (e.g. +14155552671).
signup.invalid_country: Country code must be 2 letters (ISO 3166 alpha-2).
signup.next_steps:
[bold green]✓ Signup complete[/bold green]

Next steps:
 1. [cyan]lovarch init <project>[/cyan] — create a new project
 2. [cyan]lovarch audit <project>[/cyan] — verify inputs
 3. [cyan]lovarch run dal-brief-al-cantiere[/cyan] — run workflow

Upgrade to Premium (credits included): [link]https://app.lovarch.com/settings/credits[/link]

account.no_account: No account configured. Run 'lovarch signup' or 'lovarch login'.
account.delete_warning_body:
You are about to delete your lovarch-cli account (FREE mode).

What happens:
 • Your personal data (name, email, phone) will be pseudonymized (GDPR Art. 17)
 • Your token will be revoked — you won't be able to use lovarch-cli with this account
 • The shadow account in Lovarch will be deleted
 • [bold]Optionally[/bold] we delete local projects in ~/.lovarch/projects/

[red]This action CANNOT be undone.[/red]
account.deletion_success: ✓ Account deleted. Thanks for trying lovarch-cli.

# DOSSIER {project} — {date}

Generated by lovarch-cli — {count} files bundled.

Layout:
- 00-validation/  Audit and input validation
- 01-bootstrap/   Project metadata
- 02-concept/     Moodboard and renders
- 03-tier1/       Tier 1 agents output (CAD/IFC/PDF/XLSX)
- 04-tier2/       QA reports
- 05-dossier/     Briefing-architect, regulatory, energy
- 99-other/       Files without assigned routing
